opening.argument: The material presents free Uber rides and a purported promo code worth hundreds of dollars, directing viewers to an external site to generate the code. It then requires an email address and says, “To verify the code I have to do few tasks,” while the supplied frames show “Generate code now,” “Free rides,” and a separate human-verification and survey prompt. These observable steps connect the high-value free-ride claim to data entry and task completion. The evidence does not establish that any code was delivered or redeemed.
